critical_code_review_comments: testimonials.py POST /api/admin/testimonials returns the inserted doc after a dict() copy, but pops '_id' from the wrong reference (motor mutates the passed dict, not 'doc'). Current code passes dict(doc) to insert_one so 'doc' is safe — fine, but the doc.pop('_id', None) line is effectively dead code; minor.
Seed function uses sync pymongo while router uses motor; OK because seed only runs at startup before event loop serves requests, but documenting this distinction would help future maintainers.
test_credentials: Admin endpoints intentionally NOT tested with auth per request; only unauth rejection verified.
seed_data_creation: None created. Verified existing seed (35 testimonials tkp-001..tkp-035 + shop_stats) intact before and after unauthorized admin attempts.
